params.text:
The command to clone ChatGPT with SSH is:

```bash
git clone ssh://git@172.26.116.102:2222/byteblaze/chatgpt_plugin.git
```

This command clones the ChatGPT repository (chatgpt_plugin) using SSH authentication. The repository is located at the GitLab instance with SSH access on port 2222. You can copy this command and run it in your terminal to clone the ChatGPT repository.
